prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 街道便民服务中心一窗受理事项办理台账 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 3 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "序号" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "状态" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "内容" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1932px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"A 街道便民服务中心 ledger recording each accepted service item by serial number, processing status, and a narrative description of the case.","reading":"Readers scan the 序号 and 状态 columns first to identify and triage rows, then read the 内容 column as the substantive record; comparison is mostly across statuses and case narratives, not numeric columns.","groups":["序号 and 状态 form a compact row-identification/meta pair and belong together visually.","内容 is the substantive narrative column and should receive the remaining width."],"keep_intact":["序号 header and serial digits","状态 header and status labels such as 已办结, 办理中, 已退回, 待补正","dates, amounts, permit numbers, names, and other identifiers inside 内容"],"may_wrap":["long 内容 narratives at Chinese character or punctuation boundaries","状态 labels only in a deliberately compressed design","序号 or 状态 headers only if a compact metadata rail is chosen"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [52, 67, 240] · table 360×1394px · row heights [36, 222, 222, 222, 222, 246, 222] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 10 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [64, 84, 211] · table 360×1580px · row heights [36, 246, 246, 246, 269, 269, 269] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [52, 52, 255] · table 360×1324px · row heights [36, 199, 199, 222, 222, 222, 222] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"Balanced and publication-ready: 序号 (52px → 31px text) holds the two-character header and the digits on one line, 状态 (67px → 46px text) holds three-character labels like 已办结/办理中 on one line, so every row can be triaged at a glance; 内容 takes all remaining 240px (219px text ≈ 14.6 characters per line) and the 222px rows read as even, rhythmic units. No mid-word splits, no orphan headers.","problems":"Nothing structurally wrong.
